_readme: P-8 (L-019): the six intents per map — rule the lead, never average. Each map declares which level of thinking LEADS it (soul | curriculum | ontology | experience | world | page); followers may not veto the lead. connective_heroes are pinned WITH their reason and exempt from every scoring instrument. weakness names where the map is weakest AT ITS LEAD — that is the triage. GHOST-DRAFTED entries are marked; Palle rules. Exemplar first: color's nails.

intents.soul: connective heroes — body↔queer↔subject touching in one object; not curriculum; never pruned, never scored
intents.curriculum: does the sequence teach the subject — baseline met, beats walkable, exit provable
intents.ontology: is the map the right queer kind — real anti-hero, real turn, the seam shown
intents.experience: composed, not generated — the edge fitness, desire cycles, pacing
intents.world: the map as a place — spine position, biome honesty, transitions to neighbors
intents.page: the writing carries it — walk, turn, dwells written and ruled

exemplar.note: the nails: not strictly part of the color curriculum but the artifact that connects the very body, queer, and color (Palle, L-019 verbatim). The class this register exists to protect.
